subject: Next steps + pick a 30m stakeholder window (two options preferred)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@quantiflow.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps + pick a 30m stakeholder window (two options preferred)

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap: Quantiflow is focused on embedding LLM-based semantic search in your analytics platform; main priorities are predictable per-request latency for customer queries, clear controls for data residency, and an operational rollout plan that keeps token spend in check.

Suggested next step: a 30-minute product intro + ops Q&A where we bring in infra/serving technical details (Dylan) and a short rollout checklist (Neha). To make scheduling easier, can you pick one of the two stakeholder windows below? If neither works, send a couple slots that fit your team and we’ll adapt.

Option A — compact window (preferred for cross-timezone execs)
- Wed, Jan 17 — 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET

Option B — technical-first (extra time for infra deep-dive)
- Thu, Jan 18 — 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET

If you expect to include an infra/ops lead, please share their name/email so we can make sure Dylan covers the right integration points.

Attached: 1) Redwood 30m intro agenda (one-pager) 2) a starter mutual action plan we can edit together.

A few quick notes I promised on the call:
- We can demo a dedicated routing policy for low-latency read paths (useful for interactive search).
- We have a private deployment option for strict residency requirements; we’ll bring the high-level SSO and KMS options to the call.

If helpful, here’s a direct scheduling link: https://redwoodinference.com/schedule/soojin/30m?slot=link (I’ll still send a calendar invite once we land on a time).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (pdf), QF-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@quantiflow.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@quantiflow.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps + pick a 30m stakeholder window (two options preferred)

Thanks Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap and the agenda. Option B on Thu Jan 18 at 14:00 PT works best for our team — please pencil us in for that slot. I’ve CC’d our infra lead, Tom, who will join and has a couple quick items he’d like covered: SSO options (we use Okta), authentication with internal data stores, and any minimum HW requirements if we go with Dedicated or Private.

Two quick asks before the call:
- Can you send a 1–2 slide pre-read that highlights SSO/KMS integrations?
- On data residency: does Redwood support regional pinning at the model serving level, or would that require a Private deployment?

Quoted for context: On Tue, 10 Jan 2028, Soojin Lee wrote:
> Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap: Quantiflow is focused on embedding LLM-based semantic search in your analytics platform; main priorities are predictable per-request latency for customer queries, clear controls for data residency, and an operational rollout plan that keeps token spend in check.

Looking forward — Alicia

alicia.park@quantiflow.com | +1 (650) 555-0922

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@quantiflow.com>, Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@quantiflow.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps + pick a 30m stakeholder window (two options preferred)

Perfect — thanks Alicia and welcome Tom. Thu Jan 18, 14:00 PT is locked on our side. I’ll send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Pre-read: attaching a two-slide SSO/KMS summary and a short note on regional pinning. The short answer: regional pinning for serving is available in Dedicated and Private; for hosted we offer region routing and isolated tenancy options but full per-tenant pinning to an on-prem region requires Private. We’ll run through the tradeoffs on Thursday.
- Attendees: Dylan will lead the infra portion and cover integration patterns (Okta SAML flow, token exchange, and KMS integration). Neha will cover rollout checkpoints and cost guardrails.

Attachments for the call: Redwood-SSO-KMS-brief.pdf, Redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (again), QF-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx

HubSpot: I’ve filed notes under opportunity QF-2028-039 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890) — feel free to add Tom to the contact record.

We’ll see you Jan 18 at 14:00 PT.

Regards,
— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
